summary: Lifecycle correctness verified. Request persistence precedes detached launch; duplicate starts reconcile without second execution. Terminal states require positive quiescence evidence; unknown execution holds reservations. Token/attempt fencing prevents stale claims. Lease renewal requires fresh supervisor heartbeat; expiration kills process group with descendant confirmation. Replay-safe policy with bounded attempts gates requeue. Resource reservations transactional; node re-validates to prevent race. Authorization checked at submit, claim, and node. Output contract enforced via exact set, SHA256, clean revision. Backup uses SQLite backup API with integrity check. No capability inflation: implements declared owner PC queue with POSIX SSH workers, no fleet/COS restore/autoscaling. Test evidence: 23 Linux tests pass (including lost-ack reconciliation, parallel claim atomicity, lease expiration), 4 Windows POSIX skips expected. Fresh SSH synthetic lifecycle and GPU physical verification remain pending as documented.
scope_compliance: Implementation matches declared scope: single owner SQLite/WAL queue, POSIX workers over strict SSH, no public service. Transactional CPU/RAM/GPU reservations, one active task/project, project fairness, registered argv recipes. Request persisted before detached launch, lost ack reconciles same attempt, unknown retains reservations. Worker renews lease only while heartbeat fresh, expires by killing process group. CPU masks GPUs, GPU UUID and memory admission, available RAM minus reserve; not kernel enforcement. Projects discover same owner entry, node/storage access separately authorized. No experiment adoption, paid provisioning, autoscaling, worker deployment, blanket archive, certified COS restore. Current recipe/argv checked at node, clean commit before/after, required output hashes after termination. Review binds these 6 exact source files.

acceptance_answers.duplication_and_release: No. Request persisted before detached launch. Duplicate start returns existing status without second Popen. Terminal states require positive quiescence (quiescent=True), token match, complete output contract. Unknown execution holds reservation until resolved. Supervisor confirms process group termination before terminal state.
acceptance_answers.stale_tokens: No. Each attempt generates cryptographic token. Node validates token on every RPC. Stale token/attempt rejected at observe(). Old attempt cannot claim completion after new dispatch fences it.
acceptance_answers.execution_coherence: Yes. Launch argv built from registered recipe at node. Durable request.json contains task/attempt/token/node/boot_id/gpu_ids. Lease validated before each heartbeat via token and monotonic deadline. Descendant cleanup via SIGKILL to process group, wait for termination, verify group quiescence. Output completion requires exact set, SHA256, returncode 0, clean revision.
acceptance_answers.authorization_enforcement: Yes. Submit validates project in config, recipe in policy, kind in allowed_kinds, exact revision. Claim filters by policy nodes and allowed_kinds. Worker re-validates registered recipe and policy at start. Controller resolves serverctl authorization per RPC. Projects discover same owner queue; node/storage access separately authorized.
acceptance_answers.minimum_vs_capability: Yes. Implements declared minimum: owner PC queue, POSIX SSH workers, no public service. Transactional reservations, registered recipes, explicit policies, bounded retry, output contract. Does not imply fleet management, COS certified restore, autoscaling, worker deployment, blanket archive. Backup noted as private owner PC copy, not certified control plane recovery. Experiment output persistence remains separate explicit archive process.
